title: Things to Do (for the weekend of October 1st)
description:
Looking for fun things to do around Los Angeles? From cultural festivals and night markets to family activities and Halloween fun, there’s plenty happening around L.A.!

🇰🇷 LA Korean Festival
Celebrate Korean culture with K-pop, games, artisan goods, a parade, food, entertainment, and more at Seoul International Park.
📅 October 1–4 | 10 AM–10 PM daily
🔗 LAKoreanFestival.org

🌙 Somos NELA Night Market
Spend Friday evening in Frogtown enjoying food, drinks, crafts, art, community resources, and live entertainment.
📅 Friday, October 2 | 6–9 PM
📱 Instagram: @NorthEastLA_Market

🌭 Green Meadows Fall Resources Fair
Bring the family for hot dogs grilled by LAPD, car seat checks, adult literacy resources, garden demonstrations, arts and crafts, and more.
📅 Saturday, October 3 | 11 AM–3 PM
📍 Green Meadows Recreation Center
🔗 CD9.LACity.gov

🎃 Halloween Fun at Venice Branch Library
Get into the Halloween spirit with a free costume market, classic cartoons, and Halloween favorites on the big screen, plus a chance to design your own Halloween mask.
📅 Saturday, October 3 | 11 AM–1 PM
🔗 LAPL.org/events
